Public domain: every person whose words are in this text died in 1925 or earlier, so the term has ended under the law of every country, whichever one first published it.

People: François Guizot (author, Wikidata Q157324), died 1874; Henriette Elizabeth Witt (editor, Wikidata Q16211338), died 1908. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Guizot, François, 1787-1874; Witt, Madame de (Henriette Elizabeth), 1829-1908 [Editor]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: A popular history of England : from the earliest times to the reign of Queen Victoria, New York : John W. Lovell Co.,[1850], 1850, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/popularhistoryeng03guiz. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 94%, 88%, 93% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Henriette Elizabeth Witt, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
